title: Maximum Product of Three Numbers
description: Find the maximum product of three numbers in an array, which can be the product of the three largest numbers or the two smallest numbers and the largest.
pseudocode:
1. sort(nums)
2. n = nums.length
3. option1 = nums[n-1] * nums[n-2] * nums[n-3]
4. option2 = nums[0] * nums[1] * nums[n-1]
5. return max(option1, option2)

steps.note: Sorting the array to identify potential candidates.
Calculating product of three largest numbers: 1 * 3 * 5 = 15.
Calculating product of two smallest and one largest number: -10 * -10 * 5 = 500.
